title: JRA classification standard transcription
description: One transcribed classification PDF. Verified by scripts/verify-standard-json.mjs, which additionally checks the arithmetic the schema cannot: rows must sum to their section's printed max, sections must sum to totalMarks, and the top star band must end at totalMarks.

type.description: Which establishment type this standard grades.

titleAr.description: The document's own title, as printed on its first page.

gradingMode.description: STARS: scored against star bands. CERTIFICATION: pass/fail on mandatory requirements, no stars — fast food only.

totalMarks.description: The grand total printed at the foot of the document (المجموع الكلي). Never computed — read it off the page, and let the validator prove the sections agree with it.

sourcePdf.description: Filename under public/uploads/classification/ this was transcribed from.

bands.description: Star bands as printed at the foot of the document. Required for STARS, absent for CERTIFICATION.

code.description: The shared 10-section skeleton every document follows. One icon set and one set of labels serve all seven standards, so a section must map onto one of these rather than invent its own code.

no.description: The section number printed in the document (‏.1‏, ‏.2‏ …).

nameAr.description: The section heading as printed, e.g. صالة الطعام.

max.description: The section's printed total (المجموع). Read it off the page; the validator checks the rows sum to it.

note.description: The ملاحظات column where a document prints one against a whole section — often a waiver, e.g. the restaurant standard excusing its kitchen section for venues that need no kitchen. Omit the key when the document prints none.

no.description: Printed numbering as section.row, e.g. "5.3". Unique within the file.

group.description: The الوصف العام heading a run of rows sits under. Required when basis is a dash, since it is then the only text naming the requirement.

basis.description: The أسس التصنيف cell — the requirement itself. Use "—" in both languages where the document prints a dash.

definition.description: The التعريف cell — what the requirement means in practice. Omit the key entirely when the document leaves it blank.

marks.description: The العلامات cell for this row. A row printed with a dash instead of a number carries 0.

mandatory.description: CERTIFICATION standards only: true for اجباري, false for اختياري. Mandatory marks must sum to totalMarks.

ar.description: Verbatim from the document — this is the authoritative text.

en.description: A faithful translation. Not a paraphrase and not an expansion.
